name: A Grim Fate
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.

If you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, its a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.

I know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.
narrative.objectives: Investigate Fenris Isle to the east and learn the fate of the Earthen Ring traveling party.
narrative.offerRewardText: <The corpse before you was certainly Tauren and you can tell that it was gnawed on heavily before it was tossed onto the pyre. You see no signs of the elf woman that was described to you though. Perhaps she is still alive somewhere deeper in the fortress nearby?This will be dangerous, but there's only one way to find out for sure.>
